name: PdxJsonEditor
description:
A form, drawn from a schema, for editing a nested JSON value: scalars are edited inline, and each
object or list of objects in a sub-modal of its own.

events.name: value-change
events.description: Fired when the component writes `value`. Does not bubble.

cssParts.name: entry
cssParts.description: One scalar field: its caption and its control.

cssParts.name: branch
cssParts.description: One object or list of objects: its caption, a summary and the button that opens it.

cssParts.name: dialog
cssParts.description: The sub-modal a branch opens, `role="dialog"`, appended to the page's body.
